activity.notes: Gopala founded the Pala dynasty in Bengal in the mid-eighth century after being selected by regional chiefs. Modern reconstructions of his absolute reign dates vary, so ATLAS uses the common c.750–c.770 bracket with both boundaries marked approximate and reuses the existing Pala Empire polity already used for later Pala rulers.

sources.title: Pala Kingdom: Rethinking Lordship in Early Medieval North India — SOAS
sources.citation_text: The SOAS study's chronological appendix lists Gopala I as founder and gives an approximate reigning period of 750–770 CE.

sources.title: Gopala I — Encyclopedia of Buddhism
sources.citation_text: The reference identifies Gopala as founder of the Pala dynasty in Bengal and notes his rise in the later eighth century through selection by regional chieftains.
